about: The boundaries of towns whose service areas overlap their neighbours', as in Gush Dan around Tel Aviv or around Lille. A scooter inside a town's outline counts under that town, under the smaller of two outlines that nest, and a feed keeps no scooter inside the outline of a town of its country where its operator runs no service.
areaSource: Municipalities from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL), simplified to within 20 m by scripts/update-town-outlines.mjs
